maintenance.module.name: Maintenance mode
maintenance.module.description: Closes the public site and online booking for a while, behind a page that says what is happening and how to reach the box office. Staff still sign in and work as usual: the console, Admin, the till, the door and the scanner all keep going. Switch it on for a few hours when you need to (moving to a new system, a big import) and off again when you are done. A new site starts with it on, so nothing is public until you switch it off.
maintenance.settings.notice.heading.help: Left empty, the page says "We will be back soon".
maintenance.settings.notice.message.help: What is happening, in a sentence or two. Left empty, the page says the website and online booking are closed for a short while. A blank line starts a new paragraph.
maintenance.settings.notice.back-by.help: When you expect to be back, in your own words, such as "by 6pm" or "on Monday morning". Left empty, the page gives no time.
Ask search engines to try again after
Sent with every closed page, so search engines keep your pages and come back later.
